messages:
maria-partnerships: Heads up — OrionCloud just told us their inbound manifest split: two containers, original ETA 2026-04-02 moved to 2026-04-09 and 2026-04-16. That pushes back ~40% of the Q3 dedicated GPU reservation fulfillment. We need a quick allocation plan and a decision on the joint announcement schedule.
leo-ops: ugh. which reservations / SKUs are affected?
maria-partnerships: affected reservations: R-987654, R-987655, R-987659. SKUs: RDW-GPU-A72 (x120), RDW-GPU-A40 (x80).
leo-ops: copying inventory-bot to flag them
inventory-bot: reservation R-987654 flagged delayed by partner (ETA changed). See manifest_ref: ORC-MAN-4421.
andrew-logistics: confirming — carrier updated two legs. Container 1 (ORC-MAN-4421-1) rerouted to alternate port, new ETA 2026-04-09. Container 2 (ORC-MAN-4421-2) moved to 2026-04-16. Partial customs clearance expected for container 1 only.
oliver-sales: immediate question for PM/comms: we had a joint announcement penciled for 2026-04-10 tied to the first tranche. If container 1 maybe clears on 4/09, but allocations are partial, do we hold the announcement? @maria-partnerships what’s our tolerance?
maria-partnerships: short answer: don't publish until we verify committed capacity for enterprise customers. If we can confirm >=70% of reserved units by 4/10 we could proceed with a scaled announcement. Otherwise postpone.
sam-legal: flagging contract check — check Force Majeure clauses on ORC PO 77421 and whether late arrival triggers any credit or replacement obligations. I can loop in contracts if needed.
leo-ops: ops plan suggestion: 1) hold 70% for enterprise/dedicated commits (pro-rate across affected customers), 2) backfill small dev credits for shortfall from hosted pool for PLG customers, 3) engage SI partners to delay staging cutover where required. Quick snip of allocation math:``` R-987654 (120 A72): hold 84 (70%), release 36 to hosted dev pool R-987655 (80 A40): hold 56 (70%), release 24 to hosted dev pool ```
maria-partnerships: that math makes sense. can we confirm hosted pool has capacity to absorb the released units? @leo-ops
leo-ops: checking now — hosted pool low but we can auto-spin short-term burst +borrow from Dedicated buffer (will cost more). ETA on confirmation: 30m.
andrew-logistics: also note: one of the RDW-GPU-A72 racks in container 2 failed pre-shipment test; partner replaced it and that caused the second container ETA slip. Replacement is validated but adds customs paperwork on arrival.
oliver-sales: ok — risk to customers who signed ramp SLA: who gets priority? proposal: enterprise + customers with purchase orders > $50k retain first-claim. Everyone else gets pro-rated. Thoughts?
maria-partnerships: agree with that priority. we should notify affected customers with an update and offer credits + expedited provisioning where possible. I'll draft a short customer note after we lock allocation numbers.
sam-legal: also recommend we delay any public co-branded case study until final shipment reconciliation completes. Legal sign-off needed for any announcement language referencing exact capacity/availability.
leo-ops: update: hosted pool accepted 60 released units as burst for 2 weeks; rest will come from buffer at cost delta ~+18% for the month. I'll open billing change for finance.
andrew-logistics: working with carrier to get provisional customs docs ready for container 1 — might clear early morning 2026-04-09 local port time. If that happens we could push a small early tranche (40 units) to EU edge to unblock a customer pilot.
maria-partnerships: action items: 1) leo-ops to finalize exact unit split and billing delta (due in 30m) 2) sam-legal to confirm contract remedies / credit triggers for ORC PO by EOD 3) andrew-logistics to confirm customs ETA and upload provisional docs 4) maria-partnerships to draft customer comms for affected accounts and draft hold language for announcement.
oliver-sales: thanks — if anyone needs approval to waive SLA penalties for affected customers I can escalate to CRO.
maria-partnerships: perfect. small comms draft with conservative language: "We expect a short delay in provisioning for a subset of reserved units due to partner shipping changes; we're prioritizing enterprise commitments and providing credits where needed." I’ll share a one-pager in #partnerships-updates when ready.
leo-ops: FYI I created an internal ticket: INT-7621 (allocation + billing). tagging @inventory-bot to keep the reservations updated.
inventory-bot: ticket INT-7621 linked to reservations R-987654,R-987655,R-987659. Status: open.
maria-partnerships: thanks all — will reconvene after leo updates (in ~30m). :shipit::hourglass:
